paragraphs: R. Yaakov of Kefar Ḥanan. Midrash Rabbah, at the beginning of Emor and Naso, chapter 12; Eikhah, at the verses 'How she sits,' 'All her friends have betrayed her,' and 'The Lord has done what He planned'; and Kohelet Rabbah, at 'He has made everything beautiful in its time.' In Resh Lakish's name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Ein Omedin, mishnah 2; Sanhedrin, chapter 2, halakhah 5; Ta'anit, beginning of chapter 1. In R. Abba's name, Zohar, Shemot 76.
